title: TAPS: Target-Aware Permanent Sampling for Graph Diffusion
summary: Permanent air-quality networks are expensive to install and maintain, yet many decisions depend on one future regional exposure rather than the complete pollution field. We introduce Target-Aware Permanent Sampling (TAPS), a graph-diffusion framework for selecting permanent locations observed repeatedly over time, that can reduce unnecessary sensor installations, maintenance, and cost while preserving the information needed for future air-quality decisions, subject to validation with the estimator that will use the network.
